title: NullSubschemaValuePositions
description: A {"type":"null"} sub-schema at every value position one can be written at. It is the type no Go type expresses -- *any decodes a null and every other JSON value besides -- so a position that types its values through resolveType alone drops it silently, and the generated Validate reads like a schema with nothing more to say. Two positions did: the overflow map of a struct with declared properties beside its additionalProperties, and a leftover key judged by unevaluatedProperties (issue #222). The rest are here as controls, because "fixed here, not one position over" is what this family keeps doing.
